data: According to the figure, what is the most positive valence among the four groups throughout the years?

The most positive valence among the four groups throughout the years appears to be for the 'american' group. This can be inferred from the fact that the 'american' group's line consistently stays above the other three groups' lines across all years. Additionally, the 'american' group's line shows the highest peak values compared to the other three groups.
